title: Reader feedback as catalogue blocks in core
description: Why: voting, comments, flags and Proposals are mostly built as the reader-steering plugin (PPY-77bb3b, PPY-49e9b5 1-5 stars, PPY-1546fc reader accounts, PPY-452419 conversations) but each site hand-places the islands in hooks. Make them blocks placed from data, and make the snapshot incremental before many tenants run it. Driven first by Shipped (see the Shipped-web board epic). Ends with a p.apyr.us page.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shared-tier 'what must be true' tasks: PPY-6b084f (tenant from the host), PPY-5219fc (reader identity per site), PPY-d0a3d5 (consent and analytics per tenant), PPY-1f83a6 (moderation per tenant). Reader rows get tenant keys in PPY-ef2c57.
